matches.statement: For a smooth dissipative dynamical system with a global attractor, is the supremum of the local Lyapunov dimension on the attractor attained at an equilibrium or at an unstable periodic orbit contained in the attractor?
matches.title: Eden's conjecture on local Lyapunov dimension

matches.statement: Under the hypotheses in which the Lyapunov (Kaplan–Yorke) dimension is defined from the ordered Lyapunov exponents, prove that it equals the appropriate dimension of the attractor or invariant measure.
matches.title: Kaplan–Yorke dimension conjecture

matches.title: A correction-transfer triangle for Polya, Riesz means, and normalized eigenvalue means
Eden conventions, exponential FPP clocks, and an exact finite-cluster comparison

matches.statement: For Schrödinger operators −Δ−V with bound-state energies Eⱼ<0, open Lieb–Thirring questions include: does there exist a bound ∑ⱼ|Eⱼ|^γ≤C|E₁|^γ under suitable assumptions on V; can one find a more direct proof or correction-term sharpening of the Eden–Foias inequality; can one directly estimate the eigenvalue sum without the Birman–Schwinger transformation; and, for a smooth closed curve of length 2π, is the principal eigenvalue of −d²/ds²+κ(s)² minimized by the circle (the Ovals conjecture)?
matches.title: Lieb–Thirring Refinements and the Ovals Conjecture

matches.statement: For the three-dimensional acoustic perfectly matched layer system with spatially varying damping coefficients, construct a Lyapunov function that is nonincreasing and uniformly controls the acoustic energy; in particular, control the terms created by spatial variation of the damping.
matches.title: Lyapunov Functions for Three-Dimensional Acoustic PML Systems
